WHAT IS RDWC 
Recirculating Deep Water Culture (RDWC) is an advanced hydroponic method that keeps plant roots suspended in continuously moving, oxygen-rich nutrient solution. 
Unlike traditional growing methods, RDWC creates a fully controlled root-zone environment where water, nutrients, and oxygen are delivered with precision and consistency.
